phases.title: Phase 1: Core Foundation
phases.desc: Built the modular package delivery system, combo tracking, and basic upgrade shop infrastructure.

phases.title: Phase 2: Visual Identity Overhaul
phases.goal: Establish a unique art style and scalable architecture.
phases.desc: Transitioned to a clean neon arcade aesthetic. Implemented the scalable Industrial Tunnel, tightened package routing logic, added energy VFX, and expanded the main menu UI.

phases.title: Phase 3: Polish & Early Access
phases.goal: Finalize the build for initial public release.
phases.desc: Implementing final audio/ambience, polishing UI elements, and preparing the initial playable build for Itch.io.

phases.title: Phase 4: Gameplay Expansion
phases.goal: Add variety, difficulty, and depth to the core sorting loop.
phases.desc: Actively developing more parcel varieties, random warehouse events, new levels and layouts, and additional meta-progression upgrade systems.
